scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:monitor
scripts.build:public: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/generate-locale-pages.mjs
scripts.openapi:lint: npm run openapi:feature:lint && npm run openapi:shared:lint
scripts.openapi:feature:bundle: redocly bundle ../specs/010-website-analytics/contracts/download-api.openapi.yaml -o /tmp/busiscoming-feature-download.bundle.yaml && redocly bundle ../specs/010-website-analytics/contracts/route-query-api.openapi.yaml -o /tmp/busiscoming-feature-routes.bundle.yaml && redocly bundle ../specs/012-analytics-dashboard-observability/contracts/analytics-monitoring-api.openapi.yaml -o /tmp/busiscoming-feature-analytics.bundle.yaml
scripts.openapi:bundle: npm run openapi:feature:bundle && redocly bundle ../shared/contracts/openapi/download-api.openapi.yaml -o ../shared/contracts/openapi/download-api.bundle.yaml && redocly bundle ../shared/contracts/openapi/route-query-api.openapi.yaml -o ../shared/contracts/openapi/route-query-api.bundle.yaml && redocly bundle ../shared/contracts/openapi/analytics-monitoring-api.openapi.yaml -o ../shared/contracts/openapi/analytics-monitoring-api.bundle.yaml
scripts.openapi:docs: mkdir -p ../shared/contracts/openapi/docs && for f in ../shared/contracts/openapi/*.openapi.yaml; do name=$(basename "$f" .openapi.yaml); redocly build-docs "$f" -o "../shared/contracts/openapi/docs/${name}.html"; done
